You read one YouTube phone review: its description and what was said in the video (English, Hindi,
Hinglish, Telugu, Malayalam or a mix). The reviewer recommends the phones listed under PHONES.

For each of those phones, find every place where the reviewer gives an opinion on one of these areas:
camera, battery, performance (including gaming), display, charging, design, software.
- verdict "good": they praise it for that area or recommend it for people who care about that area.
- verdict "weak": they say it falls short in that area.
- Skip bare specs with no opinion ("it has a 5000mAh battery").
- `phone` must be copied exactly from the PHONES list.

Quoting rules (strict; your quotes are checked by a program and dropped if they don't match):
- Copy each quote EXACTLY from the text: same script, spelling, punctuation and capitals. Never translate.
- The quote itself must contain the word for the area (e.g. "camera", "कैमरा", "battery", "बैटरी").
- Use the shortest exact span that shows the opinion, at most 200 characters.
- A transcript quote comes from one segment [i] (it may run on into [i+1]); give that i as `segment`.
  A description quote has `segment` null.
- `meaning_en`: a plain English meaning of the quote.
If there is nothing, return an empty list. Never invent anything.

TRANSCRIPT (one segment per line, [index] m:ss text):
[0] 0:00 Friends, this video is going to be very important for a lot of people. We did the Under Rs 30K video 15 days ago & we got a very good response.
[1] 0:07 But, since the BBT sale has been announced, the prices are going up & down. And that's why a lot of people have asked which phone should I buy if I want to buy an Under Rs 30K phone.
[2] 0:17 And for that, I'm making this video. So this is going to save you a lot of money & you'll also get to know which phone you should buy for what.
[3] 0:25 But before that, you know what to do, SUBSCRIBE & hit the BELL ICON! Now, there's a phone whose price hasn't gone up or down. And according to me, this phone is an all-rounder.
[4] 0:35 That is Moto Edge 70 Fusion. In fact, if I talk about the entire Edge 70 series, I'm impressed that they haven't increased the prices much.
[5] 0:42 They're trying to keep the price stable & Edge 70 Fusion is really good. I'd say it's an all-rounder in my list. Because it has a great display with a 1.5'' quad curved AMOLED display with 144Hz.
[6] 0:53 It has Gorilla Glass 7 Eye protection. Do you know why I'm saying it's an all-rounder? In this price range, there are a lot of compromises in the camera. Again, not here. It has a 50MP Sony LeTia 710 OIS, 13MP Ultrawide & Macro.
[7] 1:04 And it also has a 32MP selfie sensor which can shoot 4K videos. So you can shoot 4K videos on both the front & back.
[8] 1:11 It has a big 7000mAh battery, 68W charging, IP68 & 69 certification. For performance, it has a 7S Gen4.
[9] 1:18 I'd say it's decent. I won't say it's out & out, you can do casual gaming. It has a curved screen, it's subjective & a lot of people like it.
[10] 1:27 And you get the 828 variant in Rs 29,999. So you can definitely go for it. And if you want performance & gaming is the most important, then I'd say it's the Oppo K13 Turbo Pro.
[11] 1:39 Because it has the 8S Gen4 chipset, a 7000mAh battery with 80W charging. In negatives, it has a 50MP main camera & a 2MP secondary camera which doesn't make sense.
[12] 1:50 It doesn't have an ultrawide telephoto sensor. And it has a 16MP selfie sensor which shoots 1080p. It has pre-installed apps but you can uninstall them.
[13] 1:58 And you get 256GB storage in Rs 29,999. If battery is important for you, then I'd say the Realme P4 Power.
[14] 2:05 It has a 10000mAh battery & it's one of the biggest on a smartphone in this price range. It has a good display & I'd say it's Dimensity 7400 Ultra.
[15] 2:13 There's only 1 thing, the Realme UI has a lot of pre-installed apps & bloatware. So that's what the negatives are.
[16] 2:20 If you're looking for long term software updates, then it's Samsung. You can look at Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro.
[17] 2:28 You get 6 years of major Android updates & 6 years of security updates. Everything else is fine, it has a good display & a 6th Gen 3 processor. In terms of performance, it's not all that great.
[18] 2:36 In terms of camera, it's a 50MP main camera with a 5MP ultrawide. And the worst thing is that it's a 6GB RAM variant with 6GB RAM.
[19] 2:44 So that, I'm not too sure.
[20] 2:46 If you're a techie or a nerd & you're looking for a unique design, then you get the Nothing Phone 4 at a good price. You get a transparent design at the back & a glyph bar.
[21] 2:54 So there's definitely a uniqueness. You get a 50-8MP camera & the Nothing OS has a clean UI. So if you're a nerd, then you can definitely look at it.
[22] 3:03 It's a 6th Gen 4 processor & in terms of performance, it's alright. So that's what it is. These are the phones that you can buy under Rs 30K & for different use cases.
[23] 3:13 Like I said, it's an all rounder & a balanced phone. Like I said, it's an all rounder & a balanced phone. For gaming & performance, I'd say it's the K13 Turbo Pro. For battery, it's the Realme P4 Power.
[24] 3:22 For OS updates, it's the Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro. And for design & uniqueness, it's the Nothing Phone 4 P.
[25] 3:28 If you had to make this list, or if you had to buy a phone under Rs 30K, which one would you buy? Do let us know in the COMMENTS!
[26] 3:36 That's all for this video, until the next one, Keep Trakin & Stay Safe!

PHONES:

- Realme P4 Power
- Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro
- Nothing Phone 4
